and nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%')

select customer_id as customerId, streamer_id as streamerId, nickname, profile_url as profileUrl, avatar_path as avatarPath, badge, merged_into_id as mergedIntoId, first_seen_date as firstSeenDate, last_seen_date as lastSeenDate from live_customer where nickname = #{nickname} and streamer_id = #{streamerId} and merged_into_id is null
mapper.insert: insert into live_gift_record (biz_date, streamer_id, customer_id, xu, rank_no, upload_id, confirm_status, ai_confidence, create_time, update_by, update_time) select biz_date, streamer_id, #{newId}, xu, rank_no, upload_id, confirm_status, ai_confidence, create_time, update_by, update_time from live_gift_record where customer_id = #{oldId} on duplicate key update xu = live_gift_record.xu + values(xu), rank_no = case when live_gift_record.rank_no is null then values(rank_no) when values(rank_no) is null then live_gift_record.rank_no else least(live_gift_record.rank_no, values(rank_no)) end, upload_id = coalesce(live_gift_record.upload_id, values(upload_id)), confirm_status = greatest(live_gift_record.confirm_status, values(confirm_status)), ai_confidence = least(live_gift_record.ai_confidence, values(ai_confidence)), update_time = sysdate()

insert into live_chat_contact (biz_date, streamer_id, customer_id, upload_id, has_interaction, create_time) select biz_date, streamer_id, #{newId}, upload_id, has_interaction, create_time from live_chat_contact where customer_id = #{oldId} on duplicate key update upload_id = coalesce(live_chat_contact.upload_id, values(upload_id)), has_interaction = greatest(live_chat_contact.has_interaction, values(has_interaction)), create_time = least(live_chat_contact.create_time, values(create_time))

insert into live_follow_record (biz_date, streamer_id, customer_id, upload_id, follow_status, create_time, update_time) select biz_date, streamer_id, #{newId}, upload_id, follow_status, create_time, update_time from live_follow_record where customer_id = #{oldId} on duplicate key update upload_id = coalesce(live_follow_record.upload_id, values(upload_id)), follow_status = case when live_follow_record.follow_status = 'pending' or values(follow_status) = 'pending' then 'pending' else values(follow_status) end, create_time = least(live_follow_record.create_time, values(create_time)), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update live_chat_message set customer_id = #{newId} where customer_id = #{oldId}

update live_customer p join live_customer s on s.customer_id = #{secondaryId} set p.first_seen_date = case when p.first_seen_date is null then s.first_seen_date when s.first_seen_date is null then p.first_seen_date else least(p.first_seen_date, s.first_seen_date) end, p.last_seen_date = case when p.last_seen_date is null then s.last_seen_date when s.last_seen_date is null then p.last_seen_date else greatest(p.last_seen_date, s.last_seen_date) end, p.badge = if(p.badge is null or p.badge = '', s.badge, p.badge), p.profile_url = if(p.profile_url is null or p.profile_url = '', s.profile_url, p.profile_url), p.avatar_path = if(p.avatar_path is null or p.avatar_path = '', s.avatar_path, p.avatar_path), p.update_time = sysdate() where p.customer_id = #{primaryId}
update live_customer set merged_into_id = #{newId} where customer_id = #{oldId}
mapper.insert: insert into live_customer_alias (customer_id, streamer_id, nickname, source_type, first_seen_date, last_seen_date, create_time) select #{customerId}, #{streamerId}, #{nickname}, #{sourceType}, #{firstSeenDate}, #{lastSeenDate}, sysdate() where not exists ( select 1 from live_customer_alias where customer_id = #{customerId} and nickname = #{nickname} )
mapper.delete: delete from live_customer where customer_id = #{customerId} and merged_into_id is not null
